== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns Ann Glasgow. The original civil birth return records Mary Ellen, a female child born at Lisnagaver on 14 February 1867. The mother is Mary Glasgow; no father is entered.<ref>Ballymoney/Ahoghill civil birth register 1867; [https://www.irishgenealogy.ie/files/civil/birth_returns/births_1867/03501/2286677.pdf record].</ref> The identification remains uncertain.
